effect: A government with no seats in its confidence chamber now pays the largest minority penalty, 11 points of approval, instead of the smallest, 5. A seat share of exactly zero fell through to the default of one half. Countries with no confidence chamber are unaffected. Expected effect: only a government with zero seats changes. Day 0 unchanged: no government starts with zero seats (0 of 212, measured). No new state. Since fix P4 the penalty is 12 x (0.5 - seat share, support parties included), at most 6 points; a government with no seats and no support parties still pays the largest (support parties' seats now count toward the share).
